fingerprint.palette: deep petrol, mineral amber, sandy strata and pale steel
fingerprint.metaphor: a deliberately built rock descends into a well to become a test

divergence_note: Original mineral core and vertical drilling cutaways replace the previous radial water network and horizontal paper highway. Physical fabrication, downhole contact, simulated worker practice and a blocked proposal create distinct spaces in a dark mineral palette.

fauna_scope.reason: No animal illustrates the engineered mineral specimen, drilling tests, worker training or award-negotiation status.

throughline.subject: The patterned mineral-bearing rock and its vertical test well
throughline.opening_state: An intact engineered rock descends underground as an unexplained reversal
throughline.closing_state: A visibly drilled specimen withdraws and a different intact one approaches the next test

cinematic_contract.button: The next engineered rock enters because the purpose is testing the tools, not claiming a successful mine.

documentary.payoff: An engineered rock visibly descends into the test well within the first second.
documentary.source_limit: These are schematic proposed actions. DOE selected the project for award negotiations; the announcements report no completed facility or results.
documentary.hero_image: A mineral-patterned rock inside a well, with a drill above it and a sensor path returning to the surface.
documentary.closing_answer: The rock goes in so the tools can be tested, repeatedly, with results still to come.

captions.text: SMU plans a test facility at an existing drilling site in Navasota.
The team would engineer mineral-bearing rock, then place it inside existing wells.
Drilling and sensing technologies could be tested, again and again.
The project would adapt oilfield automation for mining.
Students and workers would train with AI and digital twins, alongside hands-on practice.
For now, the Energy Department has selected the project for award negotiations.
These announcements report no completed testbed or test results.
The rock goes in so the tools can be tested.

retime_evidence._why: A cut is placed at the start of the line its scene carries. That word's time is measured when the reader paused before it and modelled by syllable weight when they did not, so this counts both rather than claiming all are measured.
